requirement.statement: The kwf asset layer SHALL embed the full language manual — every Markdown file under skill/reference/ and skill/dynamic-workflow/ — alongside the existing SKILL.md, examples, and config example. The manual SHALL be readable through the same asset API in both dev mode and a `bun build --compile` binary, so a compiled kwf used outside the repository can still serve the manual.

case.given: The kwf binary is built with bun compile
case.when: A caller lists or reads a manual document by its relative path
case.then: The asset layer SHALL return the document content from the embedded bunfs, identical to the repository source

case.when: A caller requests the manual index
case.then: The asset layer SHALL return the list of available document paths (reference and dynamic-workflow chapters plus their READMEs)

requirement.statement: The kwf CLI SHALL provide a `docs` subcommand exposing the embedded manual: `docs list` prints the document index, `docs show <path>` prints one document, and `docs search <keyword>` returns matching documents with locating context.

case.then: The CLI SHALL print every available manual document path and exit 0

case.given: A valid manual path such as dynamic-workflow/02-dsl-reference.md
case.then: The CLI SHALL print that document content; an unknown path SHALL produce a clear error and a non-zero exit

case.given: A keyword present in the manual
case.then: The CLI SHALL return the matching document paths with enough context (matching line or snippet) to locate the answer

requirement.statement: The kwf MCP server SHALL expose the manual through tools `kwf_list_docs`, `kwf_get_doc`, and `kwf_search_docs`, sharing the same backend as the `docs` CLI subcommand so behavior is identical. This lets a host coding agent discover the index, fetch a chapter, and search the manual without filesystem access to the repository.

case.then: The tool SHALL return the manual index (document paths)

case.when: A client calls kwf_get_doc with a document path
case.then: The tool SHALL return that document content, and SHALL set isError for an unknown path

case.when: A client calls kwf_search_docs with a keyword
case.then: The tool SHALL return matching document paths with locating context, in the same shape as the CLI search output
